name: qwen3.8-27b-bf16-pro6000ws-256k-bf16kv-dflash2
notes: Full-precision RTX PRO 6000 WS profile for Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B: bfloat16 model weights and bfloat16 KV cache (no quantization), 256K context, DFlash2 external block-diffusion drafter (incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2, n=7) instead of the built-in MTP head. DFlash2 requirements met: bf16 target lm_head, bfloat16 KV, FLASH_ATTN backend. The provisioner (PATCH_DFLASH2=1) syncs the drafter from R2 and applies the DFlash2 backport (vLLM PR #52816, syv-ai v0.27.1 backport vendored from noonghunna/club-3090) to the in-image vLLM at boot. --no-async-scheduling mitigates the open vllm#50021 GDN spec-decode crash exposure (shared by all spec decode on this hybrid arch); --long-prefill-token-threshold 4096 is the club-3090 HOL flag for concurrency. Measured reference (2x3090, v0.27.1+backport, 2026-08-21): DFlash2 bf16-KV/FA2 = 231 code TPS, +131% vs MTP n=4. Repo is ~55.6 GB BF16 (18 shards) + 3.85 GB drafter, both must be on R2; transfer with --stream. Runs on vastai/vllm v0.27.1-cuda-13.0; requires transformers >= 5.8.0 (verify at smoke test). language_model_only removed: checkpoint ships the full Qwen3.5 vision stack (333 model.visual.* tensors) — serves text+image+video.
